Over the last 60 sessions it has moved in a falling channel (fit R² 0.73) and sits in the lower half of the channel.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 9 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 4 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (+1.9%) came on light volume.

A daily close above $26.37 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $21.48 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
